newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN B SHARES END HIGHER ON SELECTIVE BUYING.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN B SHARES END HIGHER ON SELECTIVE BUYING.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B share index closed higher on Monday, fuelled in part by institutional buying focused on Bengang Steel Plates, brokers said.
The index gained 1.41 points or 1.07 percent to 132.88 on turnover of HK$44 million, unchanged from turnover on Friday.
The domestic A share index closed down 8.64 points or 2.14 percent to 395.19 on turnover of 5.4 billion yuan against 6.2 billion yuan in the previous session.
"Some institutions are taking new positions on Bengang," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said. "I think they targeted the counter because of its relatively low P/E ratio."
